record.oneLiner: Global cloud platform whose REST API is called with account or user API tokens created in the dashboard.
record.verdictReason: API tokens are created self-serve in the dashboard and sent as Bearer tokens. Cloudflare publishes an official remote MCP server at mcp.cloudflare.com. Breadth was not checked against the full API reference; the Global API Key and Origin CA key were not confirmed from the fetched page.

evidence.quote: Select Create Token to generate the token's secret.
Select Create Token to generate the token's secret.
at `https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp` is the only MCP server you need to work with Cloudflare.
